stem: Which statement best applies to the reaction force?

options.label: A
options.text: The reaction force is not as large as the action force.

options.label: B
options.text: The reaction force acts in the same direction as the action force.

options.label: C
options.text: The reaction force is greater than the action force.

options.label: D
options.text: The reaction force acts in the direction opposite to the action force.

visual_elements: The diagram shows a person applying an action force to a diving board with an arrow labeled 'Action force' pointing downward from the board.
